Work from home when that suits you, and step out when a task is easier in person, like catching up with a kitchen partner, onboarding riders, or sorting out an issue. *Find, sign and support good local kitchens, placed so deliveries stay short and fresh.* 




 •   Scout good, well\-rated, hygienic kitchens and negotiate meal prices
 



 •   Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective partners
 



 •   Keep a track of kitchen’s monthly availability calendar
 



 •   Screen customer reviews before kitchens see them
 



 •   Track and tag delivery complaints and flag repeat failures for a warning or suspension
 



  





**B. Rider (gig worker) management** 




*Build a reliable rider pool and keep every meal slot covered.* 




 •   Watch core supply: active riders, regularity and ratings
 



 •   Close shortages and availability gaps before they reach a meal slot
 



 •   Approve or reject riders once every document is in: RC, driving license and Aadhaar
 



 •   Onboard new riders on the Kaicho Partner app: Pickup, Delivery and Payouts
 



  





**C. Customer acquisition** 




*Grow the city’s customer base, especially at addresses where many customers eat* 




 •   Bring in customers at offices, hostels and coaching centres
 



 •   Plan and run local marketing within the allocated budget to drive app registrations
 



 •   Track and update the status of every customer lead
 



  





**D. Customer support and escalations** 




*Look after customers, and act fast when something goes wrong.* 




 •   Own the city’s support queue and resolve every ticket within 24 hours
 



 •   Step in when the system flags a problem: late rider, short count, kitchen running behind
 



 •   Dig into recurring issues to find the root cause (RCA), and fix it
 



 •   Manage escalations and report them to the founders
 



  





**What you bring** 




 •   Fluent Malayalam and good English
 



 •   A two\-wheeler and a valid driving licence
 



 •   Calm, organised, and the habit of writing down why
 



 •   Comfort with apps, dashboards and admin tools
 



 •   Laptop
 



  





**Plus, one of these backgrounds**

 0\-2 years in food delivery, hyperlocal logistics, cloud kitchen or quick commerce operations, including running a city, zone or hub, and managing delivery riders and restaurant or kitchen partners. If you are 2\+ years of experience, you are most likely over qualified. Regardless, you can still apply.
 



  





**Annual CTC range: 2\.4 LPA** 




  





**If you’re interested:** 





 DM or write to us at ceo@kaicho.app. You get brownie points for adding a cover letter with your resume.
